**Spyro Reignited Trilogy Widescreen Fix** corrects the aspect ratio, removes side bars, and provides FOV override and scaling options.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#spyro) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/SpyroReignitedTrilogy.WidescreenFix/dllmain.cpp) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/SpyroReignitedTrilogy.WidescreenFix/Falcon/Binaries/Win64/scripts/SpyroReignitedTrilogy.WidescreenFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Aspect ratio** — Correct widescreen aspect ratio scaling.
- **Side bars** — Remove the black bars at the sides of the image.

## Options

- **FOV override** — Set the field of view in degrees with `OverrideFOV`.
- **FOV scale** — Scale the field of view with `FOVScalar`.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the game’s installation folder, preserving its directory structure. The included files belong under `Falcon/Binaries/Win64`.
3. Optionally edit `Falcon/Binaries/Win64/scripts/SpyroReignitedTrilogy.WidescreenFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game.
